text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language or recognising images. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed rules, computers learn from data and improve over time. Deep learning takes this further by using large artificial neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. It helps us choose films on streaming services, suggests routes in map apps, powers voice assistants on our phones, and even filters spam from our email. AI is developing quickly and is changing the way we live and work.
